items.title: Futures Set to Trade Ahead of Jobs Data, Tech Earnings
items.summary: This week features earnings from Nvidia rival Broadcom plus reports from Dell and Hewlett Packard Enterprise.

items.title: Arista's Price Assumes The Parts Arrive On Time
items.summary: Consensus cuts the stock's earnings multiple by about a third within two years, and what decides whether that happens is component supply rather than customer demand.

items.title: Dell Stock Widens Your Portfolio Instead Of Steadying It
items.summary: Its five-year correlation to the broad market leaves real room for behavior of its own, but the swing that comes with it is far wider than the index's.

items.title: GitLab Set to Report Q2 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
items.summary: GTLB heads into Q2 earnings with cloud and AI demand driving growth, while competition and restructuring risks might weigh on results.

items.title: HPE to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in the Cards for the Stock?
items.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise's Q3 results are likely to gain from AI infrastructure, networking and hybrid cloud demand as its expanded portfolio drives growth.

items.title: MongoDB's Q2 Earnings Ahead: What's in Store for the Stock?
items.summary: MDB heads into Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings with Atlas momentum, expanding AI capabilities and stronger RPOs, while EA deal timing remains a risk.

items.title: Dell Holds Strong Before Earnings; Snowflake, Palo Alto Networks Headline Software Reports
items.summary: Dell stock is showing relative strength along with Snowflake and Palo Alto Networks as all three names get ready to report earnings.

items.title: Does Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Have the Potential to Rally 25.49% as Wall Street Analysts Expect?
items.summary: The mean of analysts' price targets for Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) points to a 25.5% upside in the stock. While this highly sought-after metric has not proven reasonably effective, strong agreement among analysts in raising earnings estimates does indicate an upside in the stock.
